claim_support.topic: same-model, budget and scope controls; complete Fable 5.1 2x2
claim_support.limit: Single-shape cells are paired re-measurements; whole-definition cells use official-evaluator timing and await the same paired rerun. One run per configuration/task; component effects are not identified by full-configuration ratios.

claim_support.topic: independent acceptance, full output/state semantics and official/stricter check differences
claim_support.limit: Independent final checks differ from agent-written generation checks. Missing lse escaped an official evaluator; finite input checks do not guarantee all execution conditions.

claim_support.topic: released failure versus repair and retimed performance
claim_support.limit: Released-version retest counts are not first-generated-attempt rates; repaired-only directories remain released failures, and correctness counts can include task-constraint violations.

claim_support.topic: kernel-span timing, input/cache identity and preserved counterexamples
claim_support.limit: Cold-L2 CUPTI spans exclude JIT, flushing and synchronization; paired, independent and session measurements cannot be spliced. Retain unmatched top-k baselines, substituted input distributions, model fallback and timer/graph-cache anomalies.

claim_support.topic: scratch ownership, counter/epoch state and stream launch
claim_support.source: Selected DSA wrappers and CUDA consumers
claim_support.limit: No device, repeated-call, multi-stream, reentrancy or multi-device qualification was executed. Missing ownership/order proof is a reuse gap, not a reproduced defect.

exclusions: Other kernel mathematical bodies and unselected solution implementations
Original agent sessions, complete KDA-0.5 prompts/workflow configuration and raw external retest artifacts were not independently reconstructed
